goals.name: Omniscience
goals.concept: Always know, fully and currently, every AI capability worth knowing (tool/skill/model/MCP/command).

goals.name: Zero friction (know -> do)
goals.concept: Any capability is one step from being activated in whatever tool you're in.

goals.name: Truth & access
goals.concept: Every entry is real, verified, and directly usable (working links, ready to run), never just a name.
goals.gap: 53.4% of tools/skills have a real link (target: ~100%)

goals.name: Autonomy
goals.concept: Runs, grows, and self-corrects continuously, for free, with no babysitting.

goals.name: Leverage
goals.concept: Makes you and your future products far faster/better at building and promoting than anyone without it.
goals.gap: leverage needs real, usable links first (= G3); then the OS creation agent

goals.name: Open infrastructure
goals.concept: Machine-readable so other systems/agents build on it; a platform, not a dashboard.

goals.name: Security & trust
goals.concept: Every creator is untrusted until proven: nothing runs un-scanned or un-sandboxed, and Eitan's data/keys can never leak.
goals.gap: scan clean; pre-flight scanner present; activator gate wired (behavioral sandbox = next level)

goals.name: Personal fit
goals.concept: Every recommendation, design and plan is tailored to Eitan's taste and workflow (Arena taste, NOSG, his stack) — a personal system, not a generic one.
goals.gap: 14% of designs taste-tagged; Arena learning live; NOSG wired (next: taste beyond designs)

goals.name: Agency/Orchestration
goals.concept: The OS is truly agentic: departments pass real work over the bus with validated hand-offs, decisions are traced, autonomy grows only under the gate and guardrails. Equal weight with all goals (owner-approved 2026-07-03).
goals.gap: beats 19; 7 hand-off docs; 13 tasks done; 11 departments; audit ok (next: more departments executing, not just assessing)
